A ⇒ B is A's MPolyfold.IsTame.tangent; lemma_8_1_9 gives the same, since the object M-polyfold of tangentEpGroupoid is tangentPolyfold. B ⇒ A fails for a genuine reason. A also contains the retraction-level lemmas of the proof: the presentation T' of TC = C¹ ⊕ E and d_{TC}(a, b) = d_C(a); the first row and vertical part of D(Tr); Tr tame for T' and in general; T(O, C, E) a tame retract. It also contains Part I's presentation independence ScRetraction.IsTameWith.isTame. B, a statement about M-polyfolds, does not address any of these. Deriving them would mean re-proving TangentTame.lean's sc-calculus outright, not from B. B_to_A_main (rt_check OK) proves A's M-polyfold / ep-groupoid conjuncts from B. These are MPolyfold.IsTame.tangent (B applied to the trivial ep-groupoid of P), lemma_8_1_9, and isTame_tangentEpGroupoid_trivial_rn (from lemma_8_1_9 and Chapter 7's isTame_trivial_rn). The project's reading 'tame chart = chart modelled on a tame retract' does not enter either statement. Universes at 0 where present; the retraction-level lemmas have none.
